name: Hidden Door
tagline: AI roleplay games set in your favorite story worlds.
description: Hidden Door is a social AI storytelling platform where players roleplay collaborative adventures guided by an AI Narrator, presented as interactive graphic novels. It launched with public-domain worlds like Pride and Prejudice, The Call of Cthulhu, and The Wizard of Oz, and licenses IP through revenue-share with creators rather than training on their work without permission. Every playthrough differs because choices reshape the story.
insight: Co-founded by Hilary Mason — the data scientist behind Fast Forward Labs (acquired by Cloudera) and ex-chief-scientist at bit.ly.
edge: Licenses fictional worlds via revenue-share with creators rather than training on their work without permission, unlike most AI roleplay apps.
cons: Casual storytelling, not a full RPG
Experience depends on the chosen world

references.title: Hidden Door launches AI role-playing platform for fan fiction
